prompt:
Create exactly ONE finished 2D animation character asset for the short film “来电”: Xiaoman trying to operate a traditional shadow puppet, full-body, STANDING and facing screen RIGHT in a clear side profile. This is a single new standing pose, using the three provided images as character identity/style references.

REFERENCE PRIORITY:
Image 1 (xiaoman_turnaround_v4_draft.png): primary reference for the standing child's body proportions, silhouette, yellow-and-white polka-dot dress, white Peter Pan collar, short puff sleeves, red plastic sandals, and the right-facing profile. Use the center side view as the primary full-body model. Preserve natural approximately 5.5-head-tall school-age child proportions.
Image 2 (xiaoman_sit_upright_side_user.png): supporting reference for Xiaoman's specific gentle round side-profile face, large brown eyes, small nose, bangs, cowlick and low twin ponytails with red pom-pom ties, and the clean outlined illustration style. Do not use this image's sitting pose or stool.
Image 3 (xiaoman_expressions_current03.png): supporting reference for facial identity and a slightly startled, wide-eyed expression. Use a restrained version of the left surprised expression, viewed from the right-facing profile.

POSE:
She is standing securely on BOTH feet in red sandals, feet facing right with a modest fore-aft stagger so both legs and sandals remain readable. Her head, chest, hips and feet all face right. The mild awkwardness comes from slightly tense raised shoulders and unevenly positioned arms, not from unstable legs. Both elbows bent naturally and comfortably. BOTH hands held out in front of her torso, clearly separated at different heights: the near-side hand around lower chest level, the far-side hand a little higher and a little farther forward, with visible separation between the hands. Each hand closes naturally around its OWN single thin short bamboo stick segment. Draw only the short hand-held section of each stick, with a small visible straight segment extending on each side of the closed fingers. The two visible ends belonging to each stick must be perfectly collinear through the palm grip. Sticks are held by curled fingers and thumb, not attached to the wrists. Short stick segments point obliquely upward-right and are clearly distinct. No full-length poles or puppet mechanism.
Face: raised eyebrows, widened eyes looking toward the unseen puppet to screen right, mouth slightly open, an earnest little moment of “I haven't got the hang of this yet.” Believable and gently comic, no exaggerated contortion. Hands and forearms anatomically clear and connected.

IDENTITY / COSTUME:
Same school-age girl as the references; neither adult nor toddler, not chibi. Dark brown straight bangs, one small crown cowlick, low twin ponytails with red fluffy pom-pom hair ties. In profile the far ponytail may be partly hidden naturally. Warm peach skin, large brown eyes, small rounded nose and chin. A knee-length yellow dress with regular small white polka dots, visible white rounded Peter Pan collar, softly gathered short puff sleeves, natural fabric waist and skirt folds. Red open-toe plastic sandals with ankle straps. Keep the dress and sandals recognizable from Image 1.

RENDERING / FRAMING:
Clean fine dark brown outlines and flat colors with only very faint form shading, matching the supplied cartoon references. Neutral even illumination. Uniform light gray solid background, no vignette, no texture, no floor line, no cast or contact shadow. No scenery. Portrait canvas, native 1024 x 1536 pixels or larger with the same 2:3 aspect ratio. The single full figure occupies 80–90 percent of canvas height, centered with comfortable space for both hands in front. Complete top cowlick, both hands, skirt, legs and both feet inside the image, no cropping.

EXCLUDE: stool, chair, turtle, crane, any puppet, lantern, flashlight, strings, long rods, additional people, additional hands, duplicate panels, letters, labels, captions, watermarks, strong directional lighting, orange lamplight, moonlight.
